RCA: Pune FTTH Regional Outage (INC-2026-0179)

Document ID: RCA_INC_2026_0179

Category: C25 — Broadband & FTTH Services

Department: Network

Customer Scope: all

Version: 1.0    Last Updated: 2026-08-08    Source Authority: Internal Knowledge Base

Incident Reference

INC-2026-0179

Problem Statement

A construction excavation severed a primary fibre trunk, affecting ~2,800 broadband customers for approximately 5.7 hours.

Root Cause

The affected trunk route lacked route diversity, meaning a single cut caused a full regional outage with no automatic failover path.

Contributing Factors

Splicing team dispatch relied on a single on-call technician for the region.

Route-diversity investment for this corridor was previously deprioritised due to lower customer density at the time of original build.

Corrective Actions

Prioritise route-diversity build-out for the Pune regional trunk given increased customer density (target: 6 months, capital planning required).

Increase on-call splicing technician coverage for the region to at least two available resources (target: 30 days).

Status

Action 2 completed; Action 1 submitted for capital budget approval; owner: Network Infrastructure team.
